name: skill-orchestrator
description: Turn spoken creative intent into sealed visual requirements, a recoverable expert DAG, and one evidence-bound OpenAI image prompt.

interface.shortDescription: From screenplay evidence to one controlled visual prompt.
interface.longDescription: A local, evidence-first creative pipeline for Codex. It aligns spoken needs, analyzes a screenplay, seals exactly one visual asset, and coordinates independent visual-development experts through a recoverable event-sourced DAG. Three confirmation gates protect intent before one Chinese OpenAI-first master prompt is written; no image, model parameters, or negative prompt are generated.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $skill-orchestrator to align this request and propose a recoverable V2 Agent DAG, or use $image-prompt-team to compile one sealed VisualAssetRequirementV1 into a confirmed visual spec and one OpenAI-first master prompt.
